chapter_label: Today / A connected visual experience platform
description: Disguise brings together software, hardware and services for live events, immersive experiences, broadcast and virtual production.
why_it_matters: Production teams can connect video, real-time engines, data and physical surfaces through one workflow. The projects in this introduction show how that approach adapts to an immersive venue, an arena, a racing experience and an xR stage.
